findings.title: MetricAlertDetectorHandler does not implement required abstract methods of StatefulDetectorHandler
findings.body: `MetricAlertDetectorHandler` is changed to inherit from `StatefulDetectorHandler[QuerySubscriptionUpdate]` with an empty `pass` body, removing its previous `evaluate` implementation. However, `StatefulDetectorHandler` is an `abc.ABC` that defines four `@abc.abstractmethod` members (`counter_names`, `get_dedupe_value`, `get_group_key_values`, and `build_occurrence_and_event_data`). Because `MetricAlertDetectorHandler` does not implement any of them, instantiating it (for example via `Detector.detector_handler` when `Detector.type == MetricAlertFire.slug`) will raise `TypeError: Can't instantiate abstract class MetricAlertDetectorHandler with abstract methods ...` at runtime.
